Peace of Mind by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Welcome to Peace of Mind, a 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath vacation retreat, tucked on the edge of the serene Somerset Bridge Community, in Seagrove Beach. Take advantage of the natural surroundings of this relaxing sanctuary, graced by the presence of a lively pond. Inside, the first floor is a blend of comfort and charm, highlighted by delightful shiplap accents throughout. A spacious open area features a living room, dining space, and a breakfast bar kitchen, serving as the central gathering point for groups of up to 8 guests. The primary bedroom, king, embodies romance and serenity, providing couples with a private retreat to unwind and reconnect. The enchanting space includes a luxurious en-suite bath, with separate shower and tub. A sliding glass door welcomes guests outside to the peaceful ambiance of the pond. Upstairs, guests are greeted by a beautifully furnished primary bedroom, king, and a bunk room, equipped with two built-in twin-over-twins, and promises endless fun for the kids.

Completing the floor plan is a shared second-floor bathroom in the hallway. Welcome! Unwind and rejuvenate at Peace of Mind. Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional. We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out to us anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line. Overview: - 600 steps (0.3 mile ) to beach (Beachwood Villas Access) - Less than 1.5 miles to Seaside -3 bedroom, 2.5 bath - 1,832 sq ft - Gated private community - Pond in the backyard - Parking for 4 cars - Propane grill - Wi-fi - 3 bikes! Overnight: - King in 1st floor primary bedroom; private bath; TV - King in 2nd floor guest bedroom; shared hall bath with shower; TV - Two twin over twin bunks in 2nd floor guest room; shared hall bath with shower; TV Additional: - Twins in 1st floor living room nook area - Twins in the 1st floor primary bedroom Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
